card.name: Small words before seeking medical help
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to", "go", "from" or "for" where the next word is likely "seek" or "seeking" (help, a doctor, treatment). Also fires on some words before infection or ketoacidosis terms in label text.

modes.label: Before seek help
modes.description: A linking word right where the text is about to say seek or seeking help or care.
modes.example: This stigma keeps people<< from>> seeking help and keeps resources from being dedicated

modes.label: Time to see a doctor
modes.description: The word "to" after "it's time" or "decide" when advice to see or contact a doctor or report something follows.
modes.example: breath – If your having trouble catching your breath, gasping or wheezing, and you haven’t been doing any strenuous exercise it’s time<< to>> see a doctor.

modes.label: Label risk-factor links
modes.description: Linking words in drug-label lists of risk factors or infections, before a named condition.
modes.example: Type 2 diabetes mellitus and pancreatic disorders (e.g., history of pancreatitis or pancreatic surgery) are also risk factors<< for>> ketoacidosis.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying seek or seeking as the next word.
card.plain: It marks the small word just before text like "seek medical help" or "see a doctor".
